subject.why: The barn is instantly recognizable with gambrel roof, hayloft, double doors, and horse weathervane.

category.why: Ground plane is solid across the base with low camera angle and simplified scenic backdrop.

clean.why: No text, UI elements, characters, or watermarks present.

framing.why: Heroic, centered composition with comfortable margins around the upper structure.

colour.why: Vibrant and warm palette with clear separation between red barn and green/blue backdrop.

detail.why: Clean, stylized forms without noisy micro-textures or extraneous clutter.

style.why: Consistent with references, showing soft satin 3D volumes and smooth shading.
